headline: Spain attacks 'selfish' response of some EU countries to Ceuta migrant crossings
summary: Spain has criticized certain EU countries for their "selfish" reaction to migrant crossings in Ceuta. Italy temporarily suspended the Schengen arrangement with Spain due to the situation. Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni called the scenes in Ceuta "shocking."

headline: Mountaineer Nirmal Purja killed in Pakistan avalanche, his company says
summary: Renowned mountaineer Nirmal Purja has tragically died in a Pakistan avalanche. He was famous for scaling the world's 14 highest peaks in record time in 2019. His company confirmed the news of his death.

headline: Sir John Curtice: The 'Burnham bounce' is real but it's not massive
